{{Quote|This is the story of a great warrior. His name is Busteromuchmacho, or Buster for short, and he is the smallest and bravest of all Jedi&hellip;|Excerpt from the holobook|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''''Busteromuchmacho and the Arc to Infinity''''' was a volume of the ''[[Squib Jedi]]'' series of [[Youngling/Legends|children's]] [[Holobook/Legends|holobooks]]. In the story, the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Busteromuchmacho]] went on a quest for the origin of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] itself. The many dangers he faced included the crossing of a seemingly endless bridge between the [[Star/Legends|stars]], as well as confrontations with a [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], a [[Force demon]], and a trans-dimensional gamester
of life-and-[[Death/Legends|death]]. When [[Halagad Ventor]] was a child, his [[Parent/Legends|father]] often read it to him as a bedtime story.
